latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of interface-health skill.
- Provides multi-vendor interface and link health assessment for Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Juniper JunOS, and Arista EOS.
- Analyzes error counters, optical power levels, discard rates, interface resets/flaps, and link utilization using severity-tiered thresholds.
- Includes step-by-step diagnostic workflow with vendor-specific CLI commands and detailed metric descriptions.
- Designed for troubleshooting, baseline validation, alarm response, and performance monitoring of network interfaces.
- Requires only read-only SSH access and supports both copper and fiber interfaces with DOM capabilities.
